title: 3 piece christmas quilt set
text: 3 piece christmas quilt set. I ordered the queen size... it's quite heavy - I was surprised at how heavy.  The colors are nice and rich and the pattern is really cute.  A little rustic, but not really masculine - just personal opinion.  It does have a red and a darker beige plaid on the reverse, so technically you could reverse it - but it's a bit too much plaid for me, again, personal opinion.  The slipcovers are big - which is great for me as my throw pillows are big and memory foam - should be no trouble. I love quilts as they are machine wash and dry.  This will be really great through the winter.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
